fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) fell -4.08% to $337.75 following reports of Senate Democrats' planned investigation into Epstein-related matters, nearly reversing all post-election gains.
fields.summary_ko.1: The Senate Finance Committee plans to investigate JPMorgan's handling of Epstein transactions (comparing $130 million in suspicious activity reports versus $4.3 million during his lifetime), with scope likely expanding to subpoena bank records, internal emails, and compliance files.
fields.summary_ko.2: Analyst consensus is positive with 10 buys and 9 holds among 19 analysts, and the 12-month average target price of $373.81 implies +10.6% upside from current levels.
